newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary forint eases vs dlr, steady vs NBH basket.
newsitem.headline: Hungary forint eases vs dlr, steady vs NBH basket.

text.p: The Hungarian forint opened easier against the dollar on Friday on the mark's overnight losses in quiet trade.
The forint opened at 185.05/10 to one dollar, compared to Thursday's close of 184.50/55.
"We have yet to see the first deal struck so clearly it's going to be a quiet day," said Peter Benda of Citibank 10 minutes into trading.
Dealers said they expect the forint to stay close to the central bank resistance level and to follow movements of the dollar/mark.
(NBH basket: 30 percent dollar, 70 percent German mark.)
